findings.highlight: I have to go take her some water
findings.evidenceJa: 水を替えないとまずい
findings.governingReading: he needs to replace Sakura’s water
findings.explanation: The English changes replacing the water already left beside Sakura into bringing water to her.

findings.highlight: I had my eyes closed anyway
findings.evidenceJa: 実際さっきまで目を瞑って作業をしていた
findings.governingReading: he had actually been doing the work with his eyes shut until just now
findings.explanation: The English removes both the work and its duration, weakening the physical comedy of Shirou tending Sakura blindly.

findings.highlight: Everywhere I take a step and everything that touches my hand makes a sticky sound
findings.evidenceJa: 足につくもの、手につくもの全てが、ぬちゃりと音をたてている
findings.governingReading: everything sticking to his feet and hands makes a wet, sticky squelch
findings.explanation: Objects adhering to Shirou’s body become locations he steps and things that touch him; the wet squelching sound is generalized.

findings.highlight: The red sun
findings.evidenceJa: 赤い[ruby text=め]陽
findings.governingReading: the red sun read simultaneously as a red eye
findings.explanation: mirror moon drops the ruby that makes the watching sun an eye.

findings.highlight: some kind of evacuation notice and I was the only one who didn’t get it
findings.evidenceJa: 自分だけ気が付かないまま、大がかりな避難勧告でもあった
findings.governingReading: perhaps a large-scale evacuation advisory occurred without only him noticing
findings.explanation: Failure to notice a possible public event becomes failure to receive a notice.

findings.highlight: There’s nobody in the school either
findings.evidenceJa: 校庭にも人気はない
findings.governingReading: there is no sign of anyone in the schoolyard either
findings.explanation: The empty exterior schoolyard is generalized to the whole school before Shirou enters it.

findings.highlight: it’s as slow as moving through water
findings.evidenceJa: 水中を進むようにもどかしい
findings.governingReading: his attempt is frustrating, like trying to move through water
findings.explanation: The English preserves slowness but removes Shirou’s desperate frustration.

findings.highlight: Hahaha… mmm
findings.evidenceJa: ふふふ……ん
findings.governingReading: a low, lingering sensual chuckle
findings.explanation: The loud English laugh breaks the predatory, intimate register.

findings.highlight: filled with desire
findings.evidenceJa: 期待に満ちている
findings.governingReading: filled with expectation
findings.explanation: mirror moon sexualizes the voice more explicitly and removes its anticipatory focus on Shirou’s arrival.

findings.highlight: A fly being played with by an orb-weaver
findings.evidenceJa: 女郎蜘蛛に弄ばれる羽虫
findings.governingReading: a winged insect toyed with by a jorougumo, a spider name carrying “woman” and courtesan associations
findings.explanation: The English narrows the prey to a fly and loses the woman-spider lexical mechanism connecting Rin’s allure to predation.

findings.highlight: she confirms that the secret really was a feeding
findings.evidenceJa: 捕食だったのだと頷いた
findings.governingReading: Shirou acknowledges that the secret act was indeed predation
findings.explanation: mirror moon assigns Shirou’s realization to Rin and turns his inference into her confirmation.

findings.highlight: At the nape of my neck
findings.evidenceJa: 首筋に横から
findings.governingReading: against the side of his neck
findings.explanation: mirror moon moves Rin’s mouth from the side of Shirou’s neck to its back.

findings.highlight: when a spider consumes its prey, it begins by anesthetizing it
findings.evidenceJa: 蜘蛛は獲物を仕留める時、まず麻酔毒を打つ
findings.governingReading: when a spider finishes off its prey, it first injects anesthetic poison
findings.explanation: The English removes killing, poison, and injection from the predation analogy.

findings.highlight: This anesthesia sends me into an even deeper trance
findings.evidenceJa: この麻酔もまた、恍惚をもたらした
findings.governingReading: this anesthetic likewise brought ecstasy
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes erotic rapture into a deeper altered-consciousness state unsupported by the comparison.

findings.highlight: The sensation of her lips on my skin feels so good, it’s as if I might melt away
findings.evidenceJa: 吸い付いている唇の感触が、歯が、溶ける様に気持ちいい
findings.governingReading: the sensation of the sucking lips—and the teeth—is meltingly pleasurable
findings.explanation: The English deletes the teeth from the compound sensation and turns an adverbial intensity into Shirou possibly melting.

findings.highlight: It seeps softly into my bones, my muscles,
findings.evidenceJa: 骨を、筋肉を、
findings.governingReading: it softens and macerates his bones, muscles, and skin
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces active dissolution of every tissue layer with harmless liquid seeping.

findings.highlight: unable to even moan
findings.evidenceJa: 呻きしか漏れない
findings.governingReading: nothing but groans can escape
findings.explanation: The English reverses the proposition: the damaged throat permits only groans, rather than preventing groaning.

findings.highlight: My dizziness causes my vision to blur and duplicate
findings.evidenceJa: 交錯し重複する目眩の絨毯
findings.governingReading: a carpet of intersecting, overlapping dizziness
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents blurred double vision and removes the surreal carpet image.

findings.highlight: While still being eaten
findings.evidenceJa: 食いついたままで
findings.governingReading: while Rin remains bitten or latched onto him
findings.explanation: The grammatical roles reverse: Rin is still feeding on Shirou, but the English makes the implied speaker the one being eaten.

findings.highlight: It’s as though there’s a pump inside me
findings.evidenceJa: 中からポンプの様に汲み出されている
findings.governingReading: he is being pumped out from within
findings.explanation: The English retains the pump but omits the extraction it performs.
